title: Invertibility of the prescribed open reduction mate
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, Operations o, a normalized RealizationModel m [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], and a quasi-compact open immersion j:X->Y such that l is invertible in both schemes global sections. For a constructible complete integral K with Good reduction and Good o.shriek(j)(reduction K), the actual reconstruction unit at ringedOpen(j)(K) and the actual map m.openReduction(j)(K) are invertible.

source.place: Primitive tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction unit/counit comparisons; agent-formulated component of lem-sf-integral-basic-realization.

proof.text: Extract the single ordered Tor interval from Good(reduction K), as defined by LevelBounds. For every positive index, the calculus reductionEvaluation isomorphism identifies the evaluated reduction system with the actual scalarReductionDerivedExtension of K. In the representative definition of Tor amplitude, compose each representative isomorphism with the inverse reductionEvaluation component. This transports the same Tor interval to every actual finite reduction. Together with hK this proves finiteTorConstructibleIntegral K.

Apply openReconstructionEffectivity to the same Operations o, the same normalized RealizationModel m, the same quasi-compact open immersion j and K, using its finite-Tor constructible branch. Its conclusions are exactly invertibility of m.openReduction at K and invertibility of the actual reconstruction unit at ringedOpen(j)(K). Reverse the conjunction. The stronger theorem needs neither characteristic hypotheses nor the Good output hypothesis. No adjunction or realization model is replaced, and the empty and identity opens are included.

proof_origin.place: Primitive open-factor normalization; J9 uses the existing openReconstructionEffectivity theorem after transporting the common Tor interval along reductionEvaluation.

theorem integralOpenMateNormalization (o : Operations l E) (m : RealizationModel l E o)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (K : Integral l E X) (hK : sfIntegralConstructible l E X K)
    (hg : Good l E X ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K))
    (hj : Good l E Y ((Operations.shriek l E o j).obj
      ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K))) :
    IsIso ((calculus l E Y).adjunction.unit.app ((ringedOpen l E j).obj K)) ∧
      IsIso ((m.openReduction l E j).app K)
